description: Campaigns — allow editing a not-yet-approved campaign. Add updateCampaign (owner-scoped, status-guarded, allowance-neutral), an edit route reusing the create form's field set, and an Edit entry point on the campaign detail page. Independent of the other features. Editing must NOT consume or change allowance, and must NOT undertake the P1 visual rebuild of the detail screen.
steps: In src/app/dashboard/campaigns/actions.ts add `updateCampaign(formData)`: 'use server'; read id, title, templateId, groupId, landingPageUrl; throw if any missing; `const supabase = await createClient()`; getUser, throw 'Unauthorized' if none; load the campaign owner-scoped `.from('campaigns').select('id,status').eq('id', id).eq('user_id', user.id).single()`; if missing throw; if campaign.status is NOT 'pending_approval' and NOT 'draft' throw new Error('This campaign can no longer be edited because it has already been sent or rejected.'); update `.from('campaigns').update({ title, template_id: templateId, group_id: groupId, landing_page_url: landingPageUrl }).eq('id', id).eq('user_id', user.id)` — do NOT change status/requested_at/approval fields and do NOT call getEntitlement or consumeAllowance; redirect(`/dashboard/campaigns/${id}`).

Create src/app/dashboard/campaigns/[id]/edit/page.tsx (async server component): await params; `const supabase = await createClient()`; auth redirect('/login'); load the campaign owner-scoped (.eq('id',id).eq('user_id',user.id).single()); notFound() if missing. If status is not 'pending_approval'/'draft', render a .panel.empty-state explaining the campaign can't be edited anymore with a back <Link> to `/dashboard/campaigns/${id}` — do NOT render the form. Otherwise fetch templates (id,name), groups (id,name), and custom landing pages (name,url_slug) exactly as campaigns/create/page.tsx does, build the same landingPages array that prepends { url: '/fake-login', name: 'Fake Microsoft Login' }, and render the same .form-card/.form-section selects as create but with current values pre-selected: hidden <input name='id'>, title input defaultValue={campaign.title}, templateId select with the option whose value === campaign.template_id marked selected (use defaultValue on the <select> via a client-free approach: set `defaultValue={campaign.template_id}` on the <select>), groupId select defaultValue={campaign.group_id}, landingPageUrl select defaultValue={campaign.landing_page_url}; <form action={updateCampaign}>; Cancel <Link> + <SubmitButton label='Save changes' pendingLabel='Saving…' />.

In src/app/dashboard/campaigns/[id]/CampaignDetailsClient.tsx add an 'Edit campaign' <Link href={`/dashboard/campaigns/${campaign.id}/edit`}> rendered only when `campaign.status === 'pending_approval' || campaign.status === 'draft'`, placed next to the existing Delete button and styled consistently with the surrounding buttons (do NOT rebuild this screen — minimal addition only).
acceptance_criteria: updateCampaign is owner-scoped (.eq('user_id', user.id)), rejects edits when status is 'sent' or 'rejected', and never calls getEntitlement/consumeAllowance or changes status.
`/dashboard/campaigns/[id]/edit` pre-selects the campaign's current template/group/landing page and shows a blocked panel for non-editable statuses.
The campaign detail page shows an Edit link only for 'pending_approval'/'draft' campaigns.
npm run lint exits 0 and npm run build succeeds.
verification: Run `npm run build` — must complete with no errors.
Manually confirm updateCampaign contains no getEntitlement/consumeAllowance call and no status mutation, and that the status guard rejects sent/rejected.
findings: Added updateCampaign(formData) to src/app/dashboard/campaigns/actions.ts: owner-scoped (.eq('user_id', user.id) on both the select and the update), status-guarded (throws the sent/rejected message unless status is 'pending_approval' or 'draft'), and allowance-neutral — it does NOT import or call getEntitlement/consumeAllowance and only updates title/template_id/group_id/landing_page_url, leaving status/requested_at/approval fields untouched; redirects to the detail page. Created src/app/dashboard/campaigns/[id]/edit/page.tsx mirroring campaigns/create/page.tsx's field set: auth redirect('/login'), owner-scoped load with notFound() fallback, a .panel.empty-state blocked view for non-editable statuses, and a <form action={updateCampaign}> with a hidden id input and current values pre-selected via defaultValue on the title input and the template/group/landing selects (landingPages prepends the Fake Microsoft Login entry). Added an 'Edit campaign' <Link> in CampaignDetailsClient.tsx, grouped next to the existing Delete button and shown only for pending_approval/draft — kept the screen's existing raw-Tailwind styling, no visual rebuild. Verification: npm run lint exits 0; npm run build succeeds with the new /dashboard/campaigns/[id]/edit route emitted. No scratch files created.
